description: This file defines an enumeration `CalendarEventType` representing different types of calendar events such as meetings, calls, and tasks. It includes methods to get the display name for each event type.

classes.name: CalendarEventType
classes.description: An enum class representing various calendar event types with a method to retrieve their bean type string.

methods.name: getBeanType
methods.description: Returns the display string associated with the calendar event type (e.g., 'Meetings', 'Calls', 'Tasks').
